title: CS-Pi: Constraint-Satisfying Flow Policy Sampling
description:
arXiv:2611.08654v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A flow-matching policy deployed in the field must often satisfy a constraint that was absent from its demonstrations, such as avoiding an obstacle it has never seen. Retraining for every new constraint is impractical, so the constraint must be enforced at inference time.
